policy.availability_rule: Do not label a provider available at a home until an address-level availability source confirms it.
policy.location_rule: ZIP code may be used inside the browser to organize a search, but exact provider availability requires an address-level check.
policy.promotion_policy: Temporary promotions, bundle discounts and limited-time gift offers are stored separately from standard pricing and must not replace the regular plan price.
policy.affiliate_policy: Affiliate availability and compensation are stored separately and do not determine provider ordering or recommendation logic.
